title: The fourth word
body: Look around your classroom. The pen in your hand, the cover of your notebook, the frame of the window — many of them are made of the same material. Three words explain why plastic spread so quickly: light, cheap and long-lasting. A plastic box is useful in a kitchen and harmless in a school bag. The trouble is the fourth word: it stays. A paper bag breaks down in a season. A plastic one may stay in the ground far longer than the person who dropped it. So is plastic good or bad? The question is not helpful. A material is neither. The answer lies in what we choose to do with it. We can reuse the bottle we bought this morning. We can upcycle an old box into a pen holder. We can carry a cloth bag and waste less. Plastic waste is a problem people made, and problems people made can be made smaller. Using it wisely, or unwisely, is the part that belongs to us.

questions.q: Why did plastic spread so quickly?
options: Because it is easy to break down.
Because it is made from wood.
Because it is light, cheap and long-lasting.
Because it was first used in classrooms.
questions.explanation: 'Three words explain why plastic spread so quickly: light, cheap and long-lasting.'

questions.q: What is "the fourth word" in the title?
options: That plastic stays for a very long time.
That plastic is cheap to make.
That plastic is useful in a kitchen.
That plastic can be carried in a bag.
questions.explanation: 'The trouble is the fourth word: it stays.'

questions.q: How does the writer answer the question "good or bad"?
options: Plastic is mostly good.
Plastic is mostly bad.
Only paper bags are good.
A material is neither; our choices decide.
questions.explanation: 'A material is neither. The answer lies in what we choose to do with it.'

questions.q: Which of these does the writer suggest doing?
options: Burning old plastic boxes.
Turning an old box into a pen holder.
Buying a new bottle every morning.
Hiding plastic waste in the ground.
questions.explanation: 'We can upcycle an old box into a pen holder.'

questions.q: What does "unwisely" mean in the last sentence?
options: in a cheap way
in a quick way
in a foolish way
in a quiet way
questions.explanation: 前缀 un- 表否定,加在 wisely 前构成反义,故意为「不明智地」。

vocab_notes.cn: 耐用的,持久的(long + lasting 合成)
